genuine_target_build.frame_scope: Individual static function frames only, not maximum dynamic call chain or interrupt-stack proof. Unchanged1024 guard.
genuine_target_build.atomic_scope: Actual cached generic ARM64 Darwin target emits inline ldaxr/stlxr and release stlr, no libatomic/runtime atomic imports; no CPU execution claim.
genuine_target_build.closure: Every union import matches exact locally pinned exports and actual58da definitions; internal npp/npr/nps/mcp/boc/bno/bpl references resolve; no init/term or TEST-SDK dependency.

limits: Expected identity/source digests are trusted labels, not authentication or global source census.
Caller boot serialization/quiescence/accessibility, wired/resident protected code/expected/workspace/latch/context and one physical-domain owner remain explicit obligations.
Known source guards and private VM allocation assumptions do not establish global exclusion completeness, physical ownership, DMA permission or readiness.
No allocation/acquire/zero/copy/retire/run is performed by this entry. Native effect backend remains absent/UNAVAILABLE before query/begin; no actual hardware writer admitted.
Same-owner controls may already exist on a failed call and remain retained. Failure output atomicity never means rollback.
